title: Environment variables
intro: OpenLDR reads environment variables when its server starts. In an installed Docker deployment, edit the private .env beside its Compose file, then recreate the affected services.

Use Settings for values that have app controls. Connectors store destination credentials. Marketplace manages registries after their first boot. Distributed sync stores its link configuration in Settings. Those saved settings do not require an environment-file edit.

You need server access and the deployment's exact Compose project, environment file and overlays. Keep those options consistent. The terminal pictures below are illustrations with placeholder commands. They do not show your server or claim that a deployment change was executed.

Preserve SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Replacing it after saved credentials exist makes them unreadable. Keep passwords, signing keys, private certificates and backups out of screenshots and version control.

tasks.title: Identify the running installation
intro: Check the application before choosing a configuration file. A source checkout and an installed Compose deployment use different startup commands.
steps: Record the running Version and Environment. This page identifies the app, but it does not expose the private environment file.
On the server, open the directory containing this installation's Compose file and .env. The illustrated ~/openldr_ce path is an example. Use your actual deployment directory.
tasks.result: You know which running deployment and configuration files the change concerns.

tasks.title: Change a startup value
intro: Agree any downtime required by the selected value. Use a private editor and preserve existing credentials.
steps: Save the current .env privately before editing. Keep it with the deployment backup and restrict access.
Change the selected value. The illustration uses LOG_LEVEL. Do not paste the placeholder example over your complete file.
Run docker compose config --quiet with the deployment's normal project, env-file and overlay options. Require exit code 0. Avoid printing the expanded configuration into shared logs.
Use docker compose up -d for the affected services. A restart alone keeps an existing container's environment. Public origin or identity changes can affect several services.
Check container state, app health, logs and the changed behavior. A healthy API does not prove external databases, login callbacks or file destinations work.
tasks.result: The new process reads the intended value. Preserve the previous configuration until the behavior has been checked.

end.title: Runtime and deployment address
paragraphs: The application parser and installer have different defaults. The parser defaults NODE_ENV to development. A deployed stack should explicitly run production. Compose-only values configure the gateway and image tags.
html:
VariableDefault or sourceMeaning
NODE_ENVParser: developmentSet production for deployed services.
PORT3000Internal API listening port.
LOG_LEVELinfoServer log level.
TRUST_PROXYUnsetTrust proxy hops for client IP attribution. Use only the actual trusted proxy chain.
OPENLDR_VERSIONDeployment image tagPin the approved application release for upgrades.
SERVER_NAME, PUBLIC_ORIGINDeployment valuesPublic hostname and complete external origin.
GATEWAY_HTTP_PORT, GATEWAY_HTTPS_PORT80, 443Published gateway ports.
TLS_MODE, LETSENCRYPT_EMAILInstaller valuesGateway certificate mode and certificate contact.
MIGRATE_ON_START, SEED_ON_STARTParser: false, falseStartup migrations and optional sample-data seeding. Upgrade procedure uses a separate migration step.

end.title: Databases and object storage
paragraphs: The internal database always uses Postgres. Select the warehouse engine through TARGET_STORE_ADAPTER. These variables configure the warehouse itself. Additional report and source connections belong in Connectors.
html:
VariableDefault or sourceMeaning
INTERNAL_DATABASE_URLRequiredApplication database, including accounts, audit and canonical resources.
TARGET_STORE_ADAPTERpgWarehouse engine: pg, mssql or mysql.
TARGET_DATABASE_URLRequired for pgPostgres warehouse connection.
MSSQL_HOST, MSSQL_DATABASE, MSSQL_USER, MSSQL_PASSWORDRequired for mssqlSQL Server warehouse connection.
MSSQL_PORT1433SQL Server warehouse port.
MSSQL_ENCRYPT, MSSQL_TRUST_SERVER_CERTfalse, trueWarehouse transport options. Check the actual server certificate requirements.
MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORDRequired for mysqlMySQL or MariaDB warehouse connection.
MYSQL_PORT3306MySQL warehouse port.
MYSQL_SSL, MYSQL_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZEDfalse, falseWarehouse TLS and certificate verification options.
BLOB_ADAPTERminioS3 adapter selector. It also supports the bundled Garage service.
S3_ENDPOINT, S3_BUCKETRequiredObject service endpoint and bucket.
S3_REGION, S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLEus-east-1, trueS3 region and path addressing.
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID, S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEYPrivate credentialsObject-storage access. Garage requires its supported key format.
GARAGE_RPC_SECRET, GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKENInstaller-generatedGarage service secrets. Preserve them with its configuration.
EVENTING_ADAPTERpgApplication event-store implementation.

end.title: Authentication and secrets
paragraphs: Use Authentication providers before changing an issuer. The application database binds to its identity namespace. Generic OIDC does not provide Keycloak user or sync-client administration.
html:
VariableDefault or sourceMeaning
AUTH_ADAPTERkeycloakkeycloak or generic oidc sign-in.
IDENTITY_ADMIN_ADAPTERDepends on AUTH_ADAPTERkeycloak or none. Generic oidc requires none.
OIDC_ISSUER_URLRequiredExpected token issuer. Preserve it for an existing identity namespace.
OIDC_WEB_CLIENT_IDopenldr-webPublic browser client id.
OIDC_AUDIENCEOptionalRequired API access-token audience when configured.
OIDC_SCOPESopenid profile emailRequested browser scopes. Must include openid.
OIDC_RESOURCEOptionalProvider resource indicator when required.
OIDC_INTERNAL_JWKS_URLOptionalExplicit server-side signing-key endpoint. Expected issuer stays unchanged.
OIDC_INTERNAL_ISSUER_URLOptionalKeycloak server-side realm address. Generic OIDC does not derive endpoints from it.
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRETPrivate deployment valuesProvider administration service account.
TLS_CERT_PATHOptionalPublic server certificate offered for central certificate download.
SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEYBase64, 32 decoded bytesSaved-credential encryption key. Preserve existing value.
AUTH_DEV_BYPASSfalseExplicit development authentication bypass. Production rejects true.
AUTH_DEV_USERNAME, AUTH_DEV_ROLESdev-admin, lab_adminActor for an explicitly enabled development bypass.

end.title: Workflow, plugin and import limits
paragraphs: Enable host-level capabilities only for the users and installations that need them. WORKFLOW_CODE_ENABLED permits authored JavaScript with host access. It is not a security sandbox. Dashboard SQL limits, workflow listener enablement and dataset publishing have Settings controls.
html:
VariableParser defaultMeaning
WORKFLOW_CODE_ENABLEDfalsePermit Code node execution with host access.
WORKFLOW_CODE_TIMEOUT_MS, WORKFLOW_CODE_MEMORY_MB5000, 128Code node time and memory limits.
WORKFLOW_HTTP_ALLOWLISTEmptyHostnames allowed for workflow HTTP requests.
WORKFLOW_FILE_MAX_BYTES52428800Workflow upload or webhook file limit.
WORKFLOW_LOOP_MAX_ITEMS100000Maximum accumulated loop output items.
WORKFLOW_FILE_ACCESS_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_FILE_ACCESS_ROOTfalse, emptyHost file access and its required folder root.
WORKFLOW_EMAIL_POLL_MIN_SECONDS, WORKFLOW_EMAIL_MAX_PER_POLL30, 50Email trigger polling floor and per-poll message limit.
FACILITY_IMPORT_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES67108864Facility register upload ceiling. Raising it also needs enough worker memory.
TERMINOLOGY_WORK_DIROptionalTerminology download and extraction directory.
PLUGIN_UI_ENABLED, PLUGIN_EGRESS_ENABLEDtrue, truePlugin page/broker and network-access master switches.
PLUGIN_DATA_MAX_DOC_BYTES8388608Maximum broker document size.
PLUGIN_CRASH_LOG_DIR.openldr/crashDurable plugin crash-marker directory.
CRASH_LOOP_THRESHOLD, CRASH_LOOP_WINDOW_SEC5, 60Crash count and measurement window.
CRASH_LOOP_BACKOFF_MS, CRASH_LOOP_BACKOFF_CAP_MS2000, 60000Initial and maximum crash-loop backoff.

end.title: Marketplace and sync configuration
paragraphs: MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY_URL or MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY_DIR seeds the initial registry only when none exist. Afterward, use Marketplace, Registries. Publishing requires its token, repository and local staging directory together.
OPENLDR_SITE_ID supplies a fallback site stamp when no saved Site ID exists. Saved sync settings take precedence. SYNC_ALLOW_INSECURE_TRANSPORT defaults false. Use HTTPS for a live central.
html:
VariableDefault or sourceMeaning
MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY_URL, MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY_DIRInitial sourceRemote registry or local bundle directory used on first setup.
MARKETPLACE_LOCAL_REGISTRY_ROOTEmptyOptional allowed root for local registry folders.
MARKETPLACE_PUBLISH_TOKEN, MARKETPLACE_PUBLISH_REPOPrivate configurationGitHub publishing credentials and destination.
MARKETPLACE_PUBLISH_BRANCHmainTarget branch for publishing proposals.
MARKETPLACE_DEV_ALLOW_UNSIGNEDfalseDevelopment-only unsigned package allowance.
